Hi Samir / Priya —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our side and proposed next steps so we keep momentum into your quarter-close: 

What we covered
- Pilot scope: ingestion + conversational triage for 2 hospital lines (~100k msgs/month)
- Success criteria: latency < 300ms p50 for user flows, cost target <$0.004 per generated token, data residency in us-east region
- Integration approach: initial sidecar deployment, then move to dedicated pool for production

Questions / asks from your team
- Who is the procurement owner that will approve a PO for a pilot? (name + email)
- Is there an existing timeline / budget window we should plan for before 31 Mar?

Suggested next steps
1) I’ll share a short summary + estimated costs (attached).
2) If you’re ready, we can lock a pilot start date and I’ll route a standard SOW for signature.
